statements.statement: The 35 FY25 capital project requests totalled the stated amount; town manager recommends funding the top 10 from free cash and unexpended capital.
Ten-year capital funding model assumes a baseline of free cash each year, rising yearly.

warnings.about: capital spending and school/municipal building borrowing
warnings.condition: if taxpayers are asked to borrow in consecutive years
warnings.prediction: Town faces less capital spending than historically due to the tax situation; borrowing for both Turkey Hill and TC Passios in consecutive years may fail
